 Free Fire India system requirements: RAM, storage and compatibility
 by 
 Divyang Makwana 
 October 29, 2026 
 in 
 Apps 
 Share on WhatsApp Share on Twitter 
 Add MobiGyaan as a preferred source on Google Free Fire India is now available as a standalone mobile game for Indian players starting 28th October, and if you are the one who is planning to install the game on your device, you should check your smartphone’s compatibility before downloading it. The standalone, newly launched Free Fire India application is highly optimized to run efficiently on lower-end devices.
 The game is designed to support a broad range of devices, and Garena has published a complete table of minimum and recommended RAM, processor, storage, and operating system requirements, which applies to the India-specific version. Garena’s existing technical requirements for the original Free Fire and Free Fire MAX should be different and provide a useful reference for Free Fire India.
 Free Fire India Minimum System Requirements (Android)
 System Requirements 
 Free Fire India 
 Operating System 
 Android 4.4 or higher 
 Minimum RAM 
 1 GB RAM 
 Processor 
 1.2 GHz dual-core or better 
 Free Storage 
 1.5 GB of free storage 
 These minimum requirements are enough for the game to launch and work, but they may not run the gameplay smoothly or allow the game to perform at its absolute best. To run the game smoothly, you will require recommended system requitements. 
 Free Fire India Recommended System Requirements (Android) – For Smooth Performance
 System Requirements 
 Free Fire India 
 Operating System 
 Android 7 or higher 
 Minimum RAM 
 3 GB RAM 
 Processor 
 1.8 GHz octa-core or better 
 Free Storage 
 3 GB+ of free storage 
 Free Fire India Minimum System Requirements (iOS)
 Requirement 
 Free Fire India 
 Operating System 
 iOS 13.0 or later 
 Storage Space 
 2 GB of free space 
 Compatibility 
 Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch models running the supported OS version 
 Note: While the game will boot and function on these minimum tiers, Garena explicitly notes that the absolute baseline configurations are intended for basic compatibility and may experience frame drops during intense graphical scenarios like complex squad battles. 
 How to Check Whether Your Phone Supports Free Fire India
 Android users can follow these steps before installing the game:
 Open Settings and check the phone’s Android version.
 Open the device information or memory section to check the available RAM, if displayed.
 Check the available internal storage under Settings.
 If the Play Store reports that the game is incompatible, the device may not meet one or more requirements. Do not assume that downloading an APK from an unofficial website will resolve the issue. Free Fire India is available as a free download and is offered as a separate application rather than an update to Free Fire MAX.
 Download Free Fire India from Google Play Store 
 Download Free Fire India from Apple App Store 
 Alternatively, Android users can search for Free Fire India on the Google Play Store, while iPhone users can check the Apple App Store. Players should verify that the publisher is Garena before installing the game. If the game does not appear in the store or the install button is unavailable, you can check again later.
 How to Download Free Fire India On Android and iPhone
 Players can follow these steps to find the official game:
 Open the Google Play Store on an Android phone or the Apple App Store on an iPhone.
 Search for “ Free Fire India “.
 Check the publisher “ Garena International III ” and app details to verify that the listing is official.
 Tap Install or Get if the option is available.
 Wait for the download and installation to complete, then open the game.
 Free Fire India is a separate application intended for the Indian market. Installing or updating Free Fire MAX does not automatically install Free Fire India.
 Free Fire India Features & Diwali Event
 The India-specific version includes locally relevant content and features intended to encourage responsible gaming. Garena says the game has been optimized for a broad range of smartphones with different hardware specifications.
 Key features include:
 Parental consent: Requirements for players under 18.
 Break reminders: Regular prompts encouraging players to take breaks.
 Playtime limits: Restrictions designed to encourage responsible gaming.
 Spending caps: Measures intended to manage in-game spending.
 India-based servers: Garena says the game uses servers located in India as part of its data protection measures.
 Localized events: In-game campaigns tailored to Indian players.
 A special Diwali campaign is scheduled to run until 15th November 2026.
 Free Fire India vs Free Fire MAX
 Free Fire India is a standalone version developed specifically for the Indian market. It has its own app listing and includes India-focused content and responsible gaming measures.
 Free Fire MAX remains a separate application. Players should know that game progress, purchases, or accounts will transfer automatically between the two versions, you will get a promp to transfer the data.
 Free Fire India Price & Availability
 Price: Free to download; in-game purchases may be available
 Availability: 28th October 2026, on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store
 Special Event: Diwali event runs until 15th November 2026
